transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get our surge huddle started. As we all know, we're currently running near capacity with 10 of 12 treatment spaces occupied, and we're monitoring a regional increase in pediatric respiratory illness that's expected to drive higher ED demand tomorrow. The good news is we have an unused observation wing with eight bays available for temporary clinical use. I have the authority to activate it and set the operating plan, but I want all of us — pediatric emergency medicine, facilities, nursing staffing, and bed management — to weigh in before we finalize that plan. Our surge policy requires that all six forecasted monitored-observation patients during the 07:00 to 13:00 window be accommodated simultaneously in the observation wing, and the main ED cannot hold monitored-observation overflow during that window. So we need to plan for at least six bays. Let's talk through staffing, facilities readiness, and bed management to make sure we're prepared.
